chapter: Forming the band in New York
title: New York and Harlem never closing
summary: He describes Harlem's all-night bars and after-hours spots.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: What was New York like at that time?

New York? Oh, my. New York never closed, especially up there in Harlem. People would close down and finish having fun downtown, used to come up to Harlem with their tuxedos on. And the bars, they stayed open 24 hours. And you went round there

hand in hand just like it's still daylight. New York was beautiful. Harlem was the place where people would go and finish the day out in different clubs, the after hours, the after hours spots downstairs, and there was nothing like it. There was nothing like it.
